title: Note: Instructions for printout and use
steps: Choose paper that matches the provided A4 or A2 file. Print at actual size (100%) rather than fitting the page unless you want a smaller copy.
Check the file’s actual pixel dimensions or vector page size. A 300 DPI label alone does not make a small image suitable for a large print.
Print one test copy first. Check the text, colours, contrast and any credit strip before making more copies.
Trim on a stable cutting surface. Keep hands clear of the blade and cut away from your body.
For wheatpasting, check that the paper, paste and surface are suitable. For stickers, check the adhesive and backing. Ask the property owner for permission before displaying work.
Avoid including identifying information you do not want to share. Choose display locations that you can reach and leave safely.
